title: Revit Working Library - Export

entries.name: PDF export reference configuration
working_guidance: use dedicated issue-ready sheets rather than ad-hoc working views
preserve governed line weights, patterns and fonts
test representative sheets at target print scale

entries.name: NWC coordination export reference configuration
working_guidance: use dedicated 3D export views rather than working views
control categories, links, phase and detail level through the export view/template
treat every option as project/BEP configuration unless separately approved as enterprise default

entries.name: IFC export reference configuration

candidate_values.property_sets: common plus governed custom mappings candidate

working_guidance: IFC version and MVD must be explicitly governed by the exchange requirement/BEP
property-set mapping should be traceable to governed parameters
linked-model federation should be intentional rather than assumed

entries.name: RVT deliverable preparation
working_guidance: prepare a controlled issue state rather than handing over an uncontrolled production state
verify links, temporary content, warnings and project information before packaging

working_rules: Export presets are implementation/configuration unless a governing standard explicitly elevates them.
Do not treat a historical preset value as the current project requirement.
Dedicated export views should be governed and repeatable where the format depends on view state.
Naming, destination, version/MVD and coordinate choices remain unresolved until their governing project or exchange source is identified.

provenance.migration_note: Export examples and option values retained as non-authoritative working data. Historical organization/client/project naming examples removed.
